products.name: Alteryx AI
products.note: Analytics automation with AI; data blending; workflow governance; self-service analytics risk

reading.body:
Alteryx provides analytics automation software that integrates AI for data blending and self-service analytics, positioning itself in the data preparation layer rather than model development or inference.

The distinction matters for AI infrastructure. Data quality and preparation consume significant engineering effort before any model sees input, yet the compute requirements here are modest compared to training or deployment. Alteryx sits upstream of the inference path, automating the human work of structuring raw data into usable form. This belongs to the broader stack, but it is not where compute constraints tighten.

The data covers a single product line and does not specify deployment scale, customer base, infrastructure needs, or power consumption. It identifies what Alteryx does, not the resource requirements that would connect it to the binding constraints on AI scaling. The category label "Data & Analytics AI" is broad enough that the actual role in any particular AI project—whether critical or peripheral—remains unclear from this entry alone.

profile_text.body:
Alteryx, founded in 2011 and headquartered in Irvine, describes itself as an agentic analytics and automation company that helps organizations turn complex data into trusted insights and decisions with AI-ready datasets, governed business logic, and visual workflows. The company's platform, Alteryx One, automates data workflows and reduces manual work by connecting enterprise systems like Oracle and Microsoft, prepping and blending data up to 100x faster, and automating repeatable analytics work while maintaining governance and lineage. The platform integrates with Snowflake, Databricks, and BI tools to deliver insights faster.

Alteryx AI is the company's primary product offering, which combines predictive analytics, machine learning, and generative AI capabilities. The platform allows business users with domain expertise to build automated data workflows for self-service analytics with risk governance. According to the company, predictive analytics automation can save up to 170 FTE hours a month, and Alteryx is rated a leader across multiple 2026 analyst evaluations for making advanced analytics and AI trustworthy at enterprise scale. The company cites customers including McLaren Racing, which uses the platform to collect and analyze on-track and off-track data for real-time performance insights, and Nielsen, which used Alteryx as the core solution for a business-wide BI overhaul.
